body: Remove the built-in nitrifier advantage from the biofilter-scaling setup. In `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_habitat_geometry_probes.rs:310-317`, each run seeds nitrifier biomass as `carrying_capacity * INITIAL_CAPACITY_FRACTION`, and `carrying_capacity` itself depends on filter-media area. Because the larger-media run is constructed with the same seed path at `:322-335`, it starts with more nitrifier biomass before any simulation dynamics occur, then the assertions at `:435-457` check for lower reduced-N exposure and higher final nitrifier biomass. That makes the probe partially tautological and weakens its ability to catch regressions in the actual biofilter growth/capacity behavior.
